hooks.name: Static quality chain on stop
hooks.description: Final static analysis gate when the agent stops: typecheck, exact pinned deps, ESLint, size limits, layer boundaries, 0 runtime cycles, 0 dead exports/types/CSS, declarative rules, 0 duplicate blocks, legacy-name guard, and brand guard.

action.command: npx tsc --noEmit && node scripts/quality/check-deps.mjs && npm run quality:lint && node scripts/quality/check-size.mjs src scripts/desktop && node scripts/quality/check-layers.mjs && node scripts/quality/check-cycles.mjs && node scripts/quality/check-deadcode.mjs && node scripts/quality/check-declarative.mjs && npm run quality:dup && node scripts/quality/check-legacy-name.mjs && node scripts/quality/check-brands.mjs
